motion_guidelines.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling is mandatory for premium feel.
motion_guidelines.reveal: Framer Motion staggered fade-up for section contents (initial opacity 0, y 20).
motion_guidelines.particles: TSParticles in Hero and Final CTA to simulate sparks/drone lights.

hero_background.description: Drone light show over a city at night

fireworks_service.description: Vibrant fireworks illuminating the night sky

testing.data_testid_rule: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case-role.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use purely pure HTML/Tailwind for structural marketing layouts. Use Framer Motion for scroll reveals and hover effects. Use customized Shadcn for forms, dialogs, and accordions. Implement TSParticles for the 'sparks' effect in hero and CTA. Strict dark theme, avoid pure black, use deep violet-tinted blacks (#030305, #0A0A12). Ensure Lenis is configured for smooth scrolling.
